orari.risposta:
We are open:
- Monday to Thursday: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM
- Friday and Saturday: 10:00 AM – 12:00 AM
- Sunday: Closed

prenotazione_telefono.domanda: How can I book a table?
prenotazione_telefono.risposta: You can call us at 922 24 78 51 to make a reservation.

prenotazione_terrazza.domanda: Can I reserve the rooftop terrace?
prenotazione_terrazza.risposta: Yes! You can reserve the rooftop terrace for exclusive use for €90.

posti_totali.risposta:
We have:
- Main terrace: 24 seats
- Indoor room: 19 seats
- Hallway: 8 seats
- Rooftop terrace: 43 seats
Total: 94 seats

menu_colazione.domanda: Do you have a breakfast menu?
menu_colazione.risposta: Yes! We have 28 breakfast options, including combos, sandwiches, and toast. Brunches must be reserved 48 hours in advance!

menu_caffe.domanda: What types of coffee do you offer?
menu_caffe.risposta: We offer 19 coffee varieties, including espresso, americano, latte macchiato, and frappé.

menu_cocktail.risposta: Some of our cocktails include mojito, margarita, and piña colada.

menu_pranzo.domanda: What do you have for lunch?
menu_pranzo.risposta: You can choose from 5 categories: starters, salads, burgers, wok dishes, and meat plates.

torte.domanda: Do you have cakes or desserts?
torte.risposta: Yes! We have fresh homemade cakes that change daily.

menu_bebidas.risposta: We offer a wide variety of drinks, including soft drinks, beers, and wines.

menu_vegano.risposta: Yes, we have several vegan options on our menu.

menu_sin_gluten.risposta: Yes, we offer gluten-free options on our menu.

menu_sin_lactosa.risposta: Yes, we have lactose-free options available.

menu_sin_nueces.risposta: Yes, we offer nut-free options on our menu.

menu_sin_huevo.risposta: Yes, we have egg-free options available.

menu_sin_pescado.risposta: Yes, we offer fish-free options on our menu.

menu_sin_carne.risposta: Yes, we have several meat-free options on our menu.

menu_sin_lacteos.risposta: Yes, we offer dairy-free options on our menu.

tipos_de_tartas.domanda: What kinds of cakes do you usually have?
tipos_de_tartas.risposta: Several types, including our most popular ones: Hummingbird Cake, Carrot Cake, Cheesecake, Baileys Cake, Maria Victoria Cake, Red Velvet Cake, Guinness Cake

mascota_permitida.risposta: Yes, pets are welcome in the dining room, on the terrace and on the rooftop terrace.

mascota_agua.domanda: Do you have water for my pet?
mascota_agua.risposta: Yes, we provide water for pets.

sillas_de_ruedas.risposta: Yes, we have wheelchair access to the main terrace and indoor room.

entrega_domicilio.risposta: No, at the moment we do not offer home delivery, but you can order for takeout.

servicio_catering.risposta: Yes, we offer catering services for events. Contact us for more details.

para_llevar.risposta: Yes, you can order any dish from our menu for takeout.

valet.risposta: No we do not offer valet parking service, but there are nearby public parking options available.

reservar_online_whatsapp.domanda: Can I book online or via WhatsApp?
reservar_online_whatsapp.risposta: For now, please call (+34 922 24 78 51). Online booking is coming soon. You can also message us on WhatsApp.

tiempo_maximo_mesa.domanda: What is the maximum table time?
tiempo_maximo_mesa.risposta: No fixed limit; if needed, we’ll kindly ask for the table with at least 1 hour’s notice.

lista_de_espera.domanda: Do you have a waitlist? How does it work?
lista_de_espera.risposta: No on regular days; during peak seasons/holidays (company dinners, Christmas, Easter, Epiphany, Carnival, etc.) we may fill up weeks in advance.

grupos_grandes_eventos.domanda: Do you accept large groups or corporate events?
grupos_grandes_eventos.risposta: Yes. Please book at least 1 week in advance so we can organize everything properly.

deposito_reservas_grupo.domanda: Do you require a deposit for group bookings?
deposito_reservas_grupo.risposta: Yes, usually 15%, payable on site by cash or card.

modificar_cancelar_reserva.domanda: Can I modify or cancel my reservation? How far in advance?
modificar_cancelar_reserva.risposta: Yes, you can modify/cancel; we don’t enforce strict deadlines—just common sense 😊.

horario_cocina.domanda: Are kitchen hours different from the venue’s?
horario_cocina.risposta: Yes. Kitchen closes at 22:30 Mon–Thu and 23:30 Fri–Sat.

festivos_horarios.domanda: Are you open on public holidays? Any special hours?
festivos_horarios.risposta: On holidays we open for half-day; closed on December 25 and January 1.

vacaciones_cierre.risposta: No, we don’t close for vacation.

brunch.risposta: Yes, brunch options available (48 h advance booking recommended). See Menus → Brunch.

menu_infantil_tronas.domanda: Do you have a kids’ menu or high chairs?
menu_infantil_tronas.risposta: Yes, kids’ options and high chairs (limited number; first-come, first-served).

cambiador_bebes.domanda: Do you have a baby changing table?
cambiador_bebes.risposta: No dedicated changing table, but we can provide a private area if needed.

opciones_sin_azucar.domanda: Do you offer no added sugar options?
opciones_sin_azucar.risposta: Yes, many items have no added sugar; sugar-free soft drinks available too.

carta_vinos_cervezas.domanda: Can I see the wine and beer list?
carta_vinos_cervezas.risposta: Sure, find it under Menus → Drinks.

cocteles_sin_alcohol.risposta: Yes—virgin mojito, lemonades, virgin piña colada, etc. See Menus → Drinks.

happy_hour_promos.domanda: Do you have happy hour or special promos?
happy_hour_promos.risposta: Yes, check Promos on the restaurant page.

precio_medio_persona.domanda: What’s the average price per person?
precio_medio_persona.risposta: It varies—depends on sharing style vs. individual dishes.

platos_para_compartir.domanda: Which dishes are best for sharing?
platos_para_compartir.risposta: Starters (croquettes, parcels, etc.); also Wok, Beef with anticucho sauce, or Fried rice with beef. See Menus → Starters.

trazas_contaminacion_alergenos.domanda: Do you inform about allergen traces and cross-contamination?
trazas_contaminacion_alergenos.risposta: Yes—our menu lets you filter common allergens. For sensitive cases, please ask our staff. See Menus.

tarta_cumpleanos_propia.domanda: Can I bring my own birthday cake? Any fee?
tarta_cumpleanos_propia.risposta: Yes! Bring your cake—we’ll provide plates, cutlery and a knife at no extra cost.

descorche_vino.domanda: Do you offer corkage if I bring my wine?
descorche_vino.risposta: Please call to discuss it when making your reservation.

fumar_terraza.domanda: Is smoking allowed on the terrace?
fumar_terraza.risposta: Yes—on the rooftop and terrace. Please keep away from children and pregnant women.

wifi_clientes.domanda: Do you have Wi-Fi for customers?
wifi_clientes.risposta: Yes, ask our staff for the password.

metodos_de_pago.domanda: Which payment methods do you accept? Card, Bizum, Apple Pay, cash?
metodos_de_pago.risposta: Cash, major cards and contactless payments (Apple Pay, etc.).
